DEEP LEARNING · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Raw data → learned features → prediction

Instead of specifying every useful pattern by hand, a deep network learns transformations across multiple layers.

questions.stem: AIలో Deep Learning అంటే ఏమిటి? Artificial Neuronsతో Multiple Layers Use చేసి Data నుంచి Patterns, Representations ఎలా Learn చేస్తుంది?
questions.figure:
MULTILAYER NEURON NETWORK

Core idea: A deep model builds representations by repeatedly applying learned transformations. Its layers need not each correspond to human-defined concepts.

Read the network from left to right: each hidden layer transforms input features before the output layer makes a prediction.
options: Deep Learning Fixed Rules మాత్రమే Follow అవుతుంది; Data నుంచి Features Learn చేయలేదు.
Multiple Neural Layers Use చేసి Data నుంచి Useful Features Learn చేస్తుంది.
Training Examplesని Only Nested Groupsగా Store చేసి Weights Learn చేయదు.
Human Experts Define చేసిన Featuresపై Statistical Tests మాత్రమే Run చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Deep Learningలో Many Neural Layers Data నుంచి Patterns Learn చేస్తాయి. Example: Imageలో First Edges, తర్వాత Shapes గుర్తించవచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Learnable Weights, Multiple Transformations, Nonlinear Activationsతో Network Hierarchical Representations Build చేస్తుంది. Layers ఎప్పుడూ Fixed Feature Roles Follow అవ్వాలని అవసరం లేదు.

questions.stem: Deep Learning ఎందుకు Develop అయింది? Traditional Machine Learningలో Manual Feature Engineering Limitationsని Raw Data నుంచి Automatic Feature Learning ఎలా Address చేస్తుంది?
questions.figure:
AUTOMATIC VERSUS MANUAL FEATURE DISCOVERY

Reason for deep learning: Learned features reduce manual engineering, but data quality and model design still matter.

Traditional pipelines often require manually selected features; deep networks can learn useful feature representations directly from data.
options: Few Examplesతో కూడా Perfect Predictions Guarantee చేసి Label Errors Eliminate చేస్తుంది.
Mathematical Optimization Remove చేసి Network Final Solutionsని Direct Memorize చేస్తుంది.
Missing, Noisy Dataని Automatic Prevent చేసి Data Preparation అవసరం లేకుండా చేస్తుంది.
Examples నుంచి Useful Features Learn చేసి Manual Feature Engineering Dependence తగ్గిస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Featuresని Every Time Manually Design చేయాల్సిన అవసరం తగ్గుతుంది. Deep Network Examples చూసి Useful Patternsని Learn చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Raw Data నుంచి Features Learn కావడం Manual Engineeringని Reduce చేస్తుంది. అయినప్పటికీ Good Data, Model Choice, Objective, Validation అవసరం. Deep Learning ప్రతి Problemకి Best కాదు.

questions.stem: Deep Learning Model Input Data నుంచి Multiple Hidden Layersలో Simple Features, Complex Patterns, High-Level Representations Build చేసి Final Prediction ఎలా ఇస్తుంది?
questions.figure:
PROGRESSIVE FEATURE HIERARCHY

Forward processing: Layers can progress from low-level visual signals to combinations useful for identifying objects. Actual features are learned.

These visual stages are illustrative. The network learns low-level and higher-level representations through its trainable layers.
options: Inputsని Successive Layersలో Transform చేసి Simple Features నుంచి Complex Patterns Build చేస్తుంది.
Raw Inputsని Intermediate Layers Skip చేసి Direct Outputకి Pass చేస్తుంది.
Intermediate Layers అన్నిటికీ Identical Representations మాత్రమే Assign చేస్తుంది.
Final Decisionని ముందే Build చేసి తర్వాత Input Layersని Reconstruct చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Data ఒక Layer నుంచి ఇంకో Layerకి Move అవుతుంది. Imageలో Edges నుంచి Shapes, చివరికి Object Prediction రావచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Forward Passలో Weights, Activations ద్వారా Representations Transform అవుతాయి. Vision Exampleలో Earlier Layers Edges, Deeper Layers Shapes/Objects Recognize చేయవచ్చు; ఇది Illustrative.

questions.stem: Forward Propagation, Loss, Backpropagation, Gradient Optimization, Activation Functions, Mini-Batchesతో Deep Learning Model ఎలా Train అవుతుంది? Depth, Width, Initialization ఎలా Affect చేస్తాయి?
questions.figure:
BATCH TRAINING CYCLE

Training: Forward → loss → gradients → update. Depth, width, initialization and activation functions affect model capacity and training stability.

Each mini-batch drives a forward pass, loss calculation, backward gradients, and parameter updates. Validation data checks generalization.
options: Prediction Error Check చేయకముందే Weightsని Randomగా Update చేస్తుంది.
Trainingలో Model Width మాత్రమే Important; Activations, Initialization Matter కావు.
Predict, Loss Compute, Backprop Gradients, Mini-Batch Updates Repeat చేస్తుంది.
Training Labelsని ప్రతి Epoch Automatically Rewrite చేసి Validation Perfect చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Trainingలో Model Predict చేస్తుంది, Mistakeని Lossగా Measure చేస్తుంది. Backpropagation Corrections Calculate చేసి Optimizer Weights Update చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Forward Pass Predictions ఇస్తుంది; Loss Targetతో Compare చేస్తుంది; Backpropagation Gradients Compute చేస్తుంది; Optimizer Mini-Batchesపై Updates చేస్తుంది. Activation Nonlinearity, Initialization, Depth, Width Trainingపై Affect చేస్తాయి.

questions.stem: Python, PyTorchలో Dataset Prepare చేసి Neural Network Define, Train, Validate చేసి Unseen Dataపై Inference ఎలా చేస్తాం?
questions.figure:
PYTORCH TRAINING VALIDATION WORKFLOW

deep_learning_train.py · PyTorch
import torch
from torch import nn
torch.manual_seed(7)
X = torch.randn(120, 4)
y = ((X[:, 0] + X[:, 1]) > 0).long()
train_x, val_x = X[:96], X[96:]
train_y, val_y = y[:96], y[96:]
model = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Linear(4, 16), nn.ReLU(),
    nn.Linear(16, 8), nn.ReLU(),
    nn.Linear(8, 2))
loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)
for epoch in range(20):
    model.train()
    for ids in torch.randperm(96).split(16):
        opt.zero_grad()
        loss = loss_fn(model(train_x[ids]), train_y[ids])
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        accuracy = (model(val_x).argmax(1) == val_y).float().mean()
    print(epoch, accuracy.item())
# Evaluate a new unseen point
with torch.no_grad():
    new_x = torch.tensor([[0.2, 0.1, -0.5, 0.3]])
    print(model(new_x).argmax(1).item())
Training and held-out evaluation

Illustration shows dataset separation, not actual training metrics. Run the code to measure validation accuracy.

A runnable mini-batch training loop in Python

Practice: Train only on the training subset. Validation uses the same model without optimizer updates, and inference evaluates an unseen feature vector.

questions.stem: CNN, RNN, Transformer, Autoencoder, GAN, Diffusion Model Architecturesలో Structures, Learning Objectives, Computer Vision, NLP, Generative AI Applications ఎలా Differ అవుతాయి?
questions.figure:
SIX DEEP LEARNING ARCHITECTURE FAMILIES

Different roles: CNNs handle spatial signals; RNNs keep sequential state; Transformers use attention; autoencoders reconstruct; GANs learn competing objectives; diffusion learns denoising.

Architectures differ in the relationships they model and their training goals: spatial filters, recurrence, attention, reconstruction, competition, or denoising.
options: Spatial, Sequential, Attention, Generative Tasksకి Different Architectures, Objectives Use చేస్తాయి.
అన్ని Architectures Same Structure; Parameter Counts మాత్రమే Different ఉంటాయి.
అన్ని Networks Text మాత్రమే Generate చేస్తాయి; Images Create చేయలేవు.
Architecturesలో Optimizer మాత్రమే Different; Structures, Objectives Same ఉంటాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Different Tasksకి Different Designs ఉపయోగపడతాయి: CNN Images, RNN Sequences, Transformer Attention, Generative Models New Data Creation.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. CNN Spatial Filters, RNN Time-State, Transformer Attention Use చేస్తాయి. Autoencoder Compress/Reconstruct చేస్తుంది; GAN Generator/Discriminatorతో Train అవుతుంది; Diffusion Noise Remove చేయడం Learn చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Billions of Parametersతో Deep Learning Scale చేసినప్పుడు Vanishing/Exploding Gradients, Overfitting, Memory, Compute, Stability Problemsని Residuals, Normalization, Regularization, Distributed Training, Mixed Precision ఎలా Handle చేస్తాయి?
questions.figure:
SCALING GRADIENT STABILITY AND DISTRIBUTED TRAINING

Scaling tactics: Residuals and normalization improve optimization; regularization helps generalization; distributed training, mixed precision and checkpointing manage resource demands.

Residual paths and normalization help optimization, while regularization, parallel training, precision choices, and checkpointing address scale.
options: Large Modelsలో Residual Connections Remove చేసి Full Precision మాత్రమే Use చేయాలి.
Distributed Training Impossible కాబట్టి Single Device మాత్రమే Prefer చేయాలి.
Parameters పెరిగితే Overfitting పూర్తిగా Disappear అయి Memory మాత్రమే Problem అవుతుంది.
Stable Gradients, Efficient Memory, Distributed Training, Careful Evaluationతో Scale చేస్తాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Big Networksకి Compute, Memory, Stability Challenges ఉంటాయి. Residuals, Normalization, Mixed Precision, Distributed Hardware Help చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Residual Connections, Normalization Gradient Flowని Improve చేయవచ్చు. Regularization Generalizationకి, Mixed Precision/Checkpointing Memoryకి, Distributed Training Scaleకి Help చేస్తాయి. Metrics Monitor చేయడం తప్పనిసరి.
